notes: The original locators use article-relative pages, excluding the author-copy cover sheet. The replication p. 10 locator identifies the pooled onset-control analysis, not the direct offset-control replication in Experiment 1 on journal p. 710. Thus the located replication contrast differs conceptually from the original duration/offset contrast; target_match refers to the supplied neutral description and page locator. No metric conversion or n reconstruction was performed. Original p is the authors’ section-wide printed significance bound, not an exact p. The narrative verdict concerns the located pooled onset analysis; the same paper separately describes the Experiment 1 offset comparison as replicating the original.
